issues.description: Inconsistent method name for the array helper used to append elements: the template's ArrayHelpers class defines a method named appendElement(T[] array, T element), while the template's Stock.addToStockIngredients(...) calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). The solution repository (reference implementation) and its Stock class use addElementToArray(...). This mismatch means the template code calls a non-existent method (addElementToArray) and will not compile for students, and it also conflicts with the helper method provided in the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the helper method name across artifacts so template code compiles and matches the reference. Recommended options: (1) Rename the method in the template ArrayHelpers from appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...), matching the callers in Stock.java and the solution; or (2) Change callers in the template (e.g., Stock.addToStockIngredients) to call appendElement(...); or (3) Add a new addElementToArray(...) wrapper in the template that delegates to appendElement(...). Also update the problem statement hint if it references a specific helper name. Ensure the final API name is consistent in template, tests, and solution.
